alt: Rocky sandstone terrain of the Isalo massif under a blue sky
caption: The eroded sandstone terrain of the Isalo massif, the heart of the drier south-west section of the route. Because this area is drier than the east, it anchors a trip taken in the wet season.

alt: Sandstone cliffs and gorges of Isalo above a track and grassland
caption: Sandstone cliffs and gorges of Isalo above grassland, reached on guided walks from Ranohira. The park requires a guide, and storms can close the canyon trails on a given day.

alt: Clear natural pool among rocks and trees in Isalo
caption: The natural pool on the Namaza circuit in Isalo, the usual swimming stop after a hot walk. The campsite near Namaza is where the one camping night of the trip is planned.

commonsFile: File:Namorona River in Ranomafana National Park 2013 1.jpg
alt: The Namorona River running through forest in Ranomafana National Park
caption: The Namorona River, which runs through Ranomafana National Park and its rainforest. This stop is the wettest on the route, with daily rain in February and March.

alt: Mist hanging over forested hills in Ranomafana National Park
caption: Mist over the forested ridges of Ranomafana. Two nights here give time for a guided daytime walk and a night walk for lemurs, with a day in hand if the weather turns.

commonsFile: File:Sleeping in a pousse-pousse Antsirabe Madagascar.jpg
alt: A pousse-pousse rickshaw parked by a railway line in Antsirabe
caption: A pousse-pousse, the hand-pulled rickshaw that serves as the local taxi in Antsirabe. The town is the first overnight stop on the RN7 and a gentle introduction to the highlands.
Terraced rice paddies around Ambositra in the Betsileo highlands. The road between Antsirabe and Ambositra runs through this landscape of small fields and brick villages.

alt: A woman preparing material for Antaimoro paper at a workshop in Ambalavao
caption: Antaimoro paper being made by hand in Ambalavao. A family workshop visit pairs with the Anja community reserve nearby and gives a craft stop on the RN7.

alt: The Rova royal compound on its hill in Antananarivo
caption: The Rova royal compound on the hill above Antananarivo, the Merina capital. It is the main sight on the arrival day, when the group recovers from the overnight flight.

alt: Baobab and spiny forest trees near Ifaty
caption: The spiny forest at Ifaty, the driest vegetation of the route, north of Toliara. The Reniala reserve is walked with a guide, and this is the planned flexible day.

alt: View of the Isalo massif from the road
caption: The Isalo massif seen from the road near Ranohira. This is the stretch of the RN7 where the FCDO advises using a recognised operator and driving in daylight only.

location: Fianarantsoa Old Town, Haute Matsiatra Region
alt: Houses of the old upper town of Fianarantsoa
caption: The old upper town of Fianarantsoa, reached between Ranomafana and Ambalavao. A walk through its streets breaks up the drive south on day 7.
